meta.persistentFactoryNote: The current Arena Match engine does not apply persistent Megafactory building levels to bot combat. Arena doctrines are currently applied to the human player only, so this bot-vs-bot matrix measures actual Arena civilizations and bot strategies, not hypothetical persistent factory bonuses.
